description: This Java class implements a Spring Batch Tasklet responsible for adding accrual entries for loan accounts up to a certain date. It utilizes services to process accruals and handles exceptions during execution.

classes.name: AddAccrualEntriesTasklet
classes.description: A Spring Batch Tasklet that performs accrual processing for loan accounts up to the current business date.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method invoked by Spring Batch to perform the task, which in turn calls addAccruals with the current date.

methods.name: addAccruals
methods.description: Helper method that delegates the accrual processing to the loanAccrualsProcessingService.
